personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, fresh, and content-forward neighbourhood feed that feels distinctly local, safe, and community-driven.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm. Cards never flush to screen edges. Whitespace provides structure.

do's: Use for bottom tab bar (when content scrolls behind it).
Use for sticky header backgrounds over the scrolling feed.
Use for bottom-sheet handles and modal scrims.
dont's: Do not use on post cards, buttons, or form fields.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Select city (Delhi NCR) and locality to join the correct neighbourhood.
screens.layout: Full-bleed image background (India Gate/Delhi scene) with a heavy bottom gradient scrim. Bottom 40% contains a solid surface card with locality picker and primary 'Join' CTA. Safe area at bottom.

screens.name: Feed
screens.purpose: Main neighbourhood news feed with text, image posts, and category tags.

states.empty: Illustration of houses with 'No posts yet. Be the first to greet your neighbours!' and a 'Create Post' CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header containing the City/Locality switcher. Scrollable list of cards (`surfaceSecondary` on `surface` background). Cards have avatar + name top-left, muted location tag (📍 Sector 14), category pill top-right, content, timestamp, and action buttons. Floating Action Button (FAB) for 'Create Post' placed at bottom right.

screens.name: Create Post
screens.purpose: Allow users to write a post, select a category, and attach images.
screens.layout: Presented as a full-screen modal or sheet. Category picker horizontally scrollable chips. Large text input area. Sticky 'Post' CTA above the keyboard.

screens.name: Events
screens.purpose: Listing of local events with RSVP functionality.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'No upcoming events.'

screens.layout: Two-column grid or list of event cards. Each card features an image with a gradient scrim, overlaying the date/time. Prominent 'RSVP' button.

screens.name: Marketplace
screens.purpose: Local directory and items for sale.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'Nothing for sale nearby.'

screens.layout: Two-column grid layout for products. Images take up the top half of the card. Price formatted with '₹'. Title and seller name below.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User details, verification badge, and past activity.
screens.layout: Cover image with user avatar overlapping. Verification badge prominently displayed next to the name. Locality listed below. Tabs or segments for 'My Posts' and 'Saved'.

avatar_user_2.alt: Portrait of an Indian man outdoors

home_cooked_food.alt: Traditional Indian meal on a tray

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette, using the Botanical Forest Green (#2E5C3B) as the core brand color to evoke trust and community. Do not introduce any blue or purple.
Implement the Feed card layout exactly as specified: avatar/name top-left, location tag (📍 Sector/City) next to timestamp, and category color-coded pills.
Apply Glassmorphism only to the floating bottom tabs and the sticky header containing the locality switcher. Ensure scrolling content blurs beautifully beneath them.
Use the Plus Jakarta Sans font for a clean, highly readable, iOS-native feel.

For any image with text overlaid (like the Onboarding screen or Event cards), you MUST apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (Layer 1: expo-linear-gradient, transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text contrast.
Ensure the Indian Rupee symbol '₹' is used for the Marketplace screen.
